chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch 366: Han Li’s Cultivation is Destroyed
chapter_meta_description: A single, kind mistake costs Han Li everything. He rescues the wrong person and is drained of all his cultivation, falling from Foundation Establishment to a mere layer of Qi Condensation. The mysterious woman knows his secret.
og_title: Han Li’s Decade of Work Is Destroyed by One Fatal Error
og_description: In a desperate escape, Han Li’s act of kindness to a fallen cultivator backfires catastrophically, stripping him of nearly all his cultivation power. He wakes to face a stranger who knows his name.
twitter_description: Han Li falls for a classic bluff, loses his cultivation, and wakes up to face a beautiful, ruthless woman who knows his biggest secret.

lore_anchors.definition: A speed-focused flying artifact, extremely fast but lacking defensive capabilities or passenger capacity.
The third major stage of cultivation in xianxia, where a cultivator condenses their energy into a solid core, vastly increasing their power and lifespan.
The first and lowest major stage of cultivation, where a practitioner gathers and refines qi within their body.
The second major stage of cultivation, signifying a solid foundation has been laid for higher cultivation.
A secret cultivation technique mentioned by name, likely a foundation-repairing method.
A pink silk scarf magical artifact that can form a powerful protective barrier when infused with demonic arts.
A type of magical array designed to deceive the senses and trap enemies within a fabricated reality.
A low-grade talisman that creates a bubble underground, allowing the user to hide within the earth.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is the woman Han Li rescued?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She is Nan Gong Wan's younger cousin. Han Li mistook her for Nan Gong Wan because of their similar appearance and her slightly husky voice.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li lose all his cultivation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His spiritual power was forcibly drained from his body by the woman's unique constitution or cultivation technique when he tried to check her injury. He was helplessly trapped until he lost consciousness.

Not necessarily. He immediately thinks of the "Three Revolutions Heavy Origin Art," hinting that a method to repair his foundation may exist, but the damage is severe and his path forward is uncertain.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the woman angry with Han Li?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She knows everything about his relationship with her cousin, Nan Gong Wan, and her first reaction to learning about him was to want to kill him for getting involved with her family.
